metadata.heading_title: Administration and Distribution of the Estate of the Bankrupt

heading.title: Administration and Distribution of the Estate of the Bankrupt

article.title: Functions of bankruptcy trustee.
article.content:
149Functions of bankruptcy trustee.

Section 149  ·  Part III · Chapter V  ·  page 113 of the Act
The bankruptcy trustee shall perform the following functions in accordance with the provisions of this Chapter—
(a) investigate the affairs of the bankrupt;
(b) realise the estate of the bankrupt; and
(c) distribute the estate of the bankrupt.
